source_name: IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File (EO BMF)
code_list_reference: IRS Publication 5926 (EO BMF data dictionary): https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/p5926.pdf

fields.meaning: Employer Identification Number — the federal tax identifier issued by the IRS, used here as the primary key. Stored zero-padded to 9 digits.
fields.limitations: Covers only tax-exempt organizations with an IRS determination. Leading zeros are significant — keep as a string, never parse to int.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary federal tax key. The strongest cross-source join key (EIN appears in IRS and, when present, SAM.gov).

fields.meaning: Legal name of the tax-exempt organization.
fields.limitations: Uppercase; truncated to IRS field length; no former-name history.

fields.meaning: 'In Care Of' name — a contact person or officer the mail should be addressed to.
fields.limitations: Often blank. May contain a role rather than a person.
fields.analysis_notes: Treat as contact, not a governance officer.

fields.meaning: Mailing street address of the organization.
fields.limitations: Mailing address (often a PO box), not necessarily a physical/registered location.
fields.analysis_notes: Combine with CITY/STATE/ZIP for a single address string.

fields.meaning: City of the mailing address.
Two-letter US state/territory postal code of the mailing address.
fields.limitations: Mailing-address state; may differ from state of incorporation.

fields.meaning: ZIP / ZIP+4 postal code of the mailing address.
fields.limitations: Keep as string (leading zeros, ZIP+4 hyphen).

fields.meaning: Group Exemption Number (GEN) — non-zero when the org is covered under a central organization's group ruling.
fields.limitations: '0000' means not part of a group ruling.
fields.analysis_notes: Indicates affiliation to a parent/central org (e.g. American Legion chapters).

fields.meaning: Internal Revenue Code subsection under section 501 that grants exemption (e.g. 03 = 501(c)(3) charity, 19 = 501(c)(19) veterans org, 05 = 501(c)(5) labor).
fields.limitations: Coded; meaning requires the Pub 5926 dictionary.
fields.analysis_notes: Best single indicator of exemption type / legal character of the nonprofit.

fields.meaning: Affiliation code — describes the organization's relationship to a national/central org and whether it is an independent, central, or subordinate organization.
fields.limitations: Coded.
fields.analysis_notes: Interpret with Pub 5926; relates to GROUP.

fields.meaning: Classification code — further subclassifies the exemption (purpose category within the subsection).
fields.limitations: Coded; combined with SUBSECTION to describe exempt purpose.

fields.meaning: Ruling date — year and month (YYYYMM) the IRS granted the exemption determination.
fields.limitations: YYYYMM only (no day). Approximates 'recognition' date, NOT the formation/incorporation date.
fields.analysis_notes: Closest available proxy for an 'established' date; mark as approximate.

fields.meaning: Whether contributions to the org are tax-deductible (1 = deductible, 2 = not deductible, 4 = deductible by treaty, etc.).
fields.limitations: Coded.

fields.meaning: Private-foundation status code — distinguishes public charities from private foundations and their subtypes.
fields.limitations: Coded.

fields.meaning: Up to three legacy 3-digit activity codes concatenated into a 9-digit string describing the org's activities (legacy field, largely superseded by NTEE_CD).
fields.limitations: Deprecated/legacy; '000000000' is effectively empty. NTEE_CD is preferred.

fields.meaning: Organization type code (1 = Corporation, 2 = Trust, 3 = Co-operative, 4 = Partnership, 5 = Association).
fields.limitations: Coded; structural form only.

fields.meaning: Tax-exempt status code (01 = unconditional exemption is the common active value; other codes indicate conditional/terminated/other statuses).
fields.limitations: The EO BMF generally lists currently-recognized orgs; revoked orgs appear in a separate Auto-Revocation list, not here.

fields.meaning: Year and month (YYYYMM) of the latest tax period for which the org filed (Form 990 series).
fields.limitations: Often blank for orgs not required to file. YYYYMM only.
fields.analysis_notes: Freshness indicator of the org's latest filing.

fields.meaning: Coded band/range for total assets (bucket code rather than an exact amount).
fields.limitations: A range code, not a value; ASSET_AMT carries the actual figure when present.

fields.meaning: Coded band/range for income.
fields.limitations: Range code, not a value.

fields.meaning: Form 990 filing-requirement code indicating which return (if any) the org must file (e.g. full 990, 990-EZ, 990-N postcard, or not required).
fields.limitations: Coded.

fields.meaning: Form 990-PF filing-requirement code (1 = files 990-PF as a private foundation, 0 = not required).
fields.limitations: Coded.

fields.meaning: Accounting period — the month (MM) the org's fiscal year ends.
fields.limitations: Two-digit month only.

fields.meaning: Total assets reported (US dollars) from the most recent return.
fields.limitations: Blank/absent for many orgs (e.g. those filing 990-N). USD, whole dollars.
fields.analysis_notes: Use with TAX_PERIOD for a point-in-time financial snapshot.

fields.meaning: Income amount (US dollars) reported on the most recent return.
fields.limitations: Blank for many orgs. USD.

fields.meaning: Total revenue (US dollars) reported on the most recent return.
fields.limitations: Blank for many orgs. USD.

fields.meaning: National Taxonomy of Exempt Entities code — standardized classification of the nonprofit's purpose/field (e.g. X20 = Christian religious org, N64 = soccer/sports club, A80 = historical org).
fields.limitations: Often blank for older records. First letter = major group.
fields.analysis_notes: Preferred activity classification for nonprofits (over the legacy ACTIVITY field).

fields.meaning: Secondary / sort name — often a chapter, location, or 'doing-business-as' qualifier used to distinguish affiliated orgs sharing a base name.
fields.limitations: Frequently blank; truncated.
fields.analysis_notes: Useful as an alternate/secondary name for chapter-style orgs.
